title: Checkout crashes with TypeError when cart is empty
body:
When I open the checkout page with an empty cart the whole app crashes.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Clear the cart
2. Go to /checkout

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
    at renderItems (/app/src/components/list.js:42:17)
    at checkoutPage (/app/src/pages/checkout.js:10:5)
    at processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
```

Expected an empty-state message instead. I think `renderItems` doesn't handle `cart.items` being undefined.

comments.body: Same here, also getting `HTTP 500 Internal Server Error` from /api/cart after that.
